Sebastian

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Eigen 3.2.6 upgrade?
parts:
We'll upgrade whenever RcppEigen upgrades.

We've now tied our chariot to theirs for better or worse.
It was necessary for CRAN, but has many drawbacks.

I do not want to go down the path of supporting multiple
concurrent versions of Eigen if we can at all avoid it.

You (Sebastian or other users) can specify your own library
version to use from RStan --- don't know if they've monkeyed
with other compatibility issues. I hope not given it's not
a major version, but they (and Boost) keep changing behaviors
that bite us.

- Bob
